description: The fabric's control channel: machine records between the control agent that runs on every account (tools/fabric/control/agentd.py, a systemd user unit) and the coordinator's fabric-ctl. One relay, the one the fleet's GZCoord traffic rides (the coordinator workspace's projects/.gzcoord/), a channel of its own whose name ends in :control so no session's inbox ever drains it (gzcoord/inbox.py refuses one). Not GZCoord messages: one JSON object per relay message, requests and replies correlated by id, addressed by convention (to: an address, a list, or *). ttl_s bounds how old a request may be when answered. state_channel carries the state records agentd posts about its account's sessions (ADR-029 rule 16), apart so a burst of replies never buries them; it ends in :control for the same reason. Env overrides: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL, FABRIC_CONTROL_CHANNEL, FABRIC_STATE_CHANNEL (tests). Written 2026-09-17 (the CEO: a real-time control plane).
